newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore hopes for open skies agreement with U.S..
newsitem.headline: Singapore hopes for open skies agreement with U.S..

text.p: Singapore looks forward to an early conclusion of an open skies agreement with the United States, a senior Singapore official said on Friday.

Teo Ming Kian, Ministry of Communications Permanent Secretary, said: "The conclusion of an open skies agreement between the U.S. and Singapore would strengthen air links between the two countries and allow the airlines of both sides to respond effectively to market forces."
A Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) statement also quoted Teo as saying: "Singapore looks forward to an early conclusion of an open skies agreement with the U.S."
The CAAS statement came after a meeting between a Singapore and a visiting U.S. delegation on the open skies question.
Under an open skies agreement, airlines of both countries are permitted to fly whatever routes they choose between one another without restrictions in frequencies, the CAAS statement said.
